lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank, extending from the branchial area toward the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting the horizontal rows of spots, forming rectangular cells and anchoring the spots at the grid vertices.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges running horizontally along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with light-reflecting dorsal edges and shadowed ventral edges.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density distribution of high-luminance spots on the leading edge and dorsal surface of the primary pectoral fin.
